notes.title: SORALAND v1.5 - New Contents Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello SORALANDERS!

We added 2 new castles to campaign mode. At every castle, you will experience different features.

Wheat Farm and Windmills

At Castle-2, we added the wheat farm area, Wheat grows faster than tomatoes. So you will get more food.

Also you can build windmills and produce food from wheat. Build a windmill and invite villager to it. Every 10 seconds, you will get 5 foods.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40509248/6216f837e14d6df781d3505d4576bb333f2ee911.png

More Enemies and Boss Fights

We added ranged attack enemies and different kinds of bosses to the game. Bosses are stronger and they have special attacks. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40509248/f063ca592d7f6c0d946eb06fc6ff64fdbcfb2236.png

The Raiders

At Castle-3, the raiders are coming to attack your villagers and buildings. You need to defend your land from them.

Towers

For defending your land from the raiders, we added towers. Towers, automatically throws arrows to the enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40509248/14a89c326797353c4c161b892639222e5e2349f4.png

Mini Games

At Castle 2 and 3, mini games are part of the game. When you play and win a game,  you will get bonus resources. While your villagers collecting resources, you can spent time at mini games and earn extra resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40509248/1515d772c96c992ac5293209399291426e28da4b.png

We hope you enjoy!
